verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships Boxes, a first-party virtual machine app that installs a chosen OS automatically, so the core VM capability is documented. Nothing in the pack names Windows as a supported guest or shows it working. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Windows guest support, details on performance and integration (drivers, shared folders, graphics), and independent hands-on reports of running Windows apps in a VM on Fedora.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run a full Windows environment in a virtual machine for apps not natively available

citations.quote: Boxes takes the guesswork out of using virtual machines. Just select the OS you want to install, and the app will do the rest.
